entries.title: Global renewable energy capacity reaches record 3,870 GW
entries.description: The International Renewable Energy Agency reports that global renewable power capacity grew by 473 GW in 2024, with solar and wind accounting for 90% of additions. This represents a 14% year-over-year increase.

entries.title: Malaria vaccine reaches 2 million children in Africa
entries.description: WHO announces that the RTS,S malaria vaccine has now been administered to over 2 million children across 12 African countries. Early data shows a 30% reduction in severe malaria cases.

entries.title: Global literacy rate reaches 87.7%, highest in human history
entries.description: UNESCO's latest report shows global adult literacy has reached 87.7%, up from 86.8% in 2020. The most significant improvements were seen in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia.

entries.title: Breakthrough in carbon capture: New technology achieves 99% efficiency
entries.description: Researchers at MIT have developed a revolutionary electrochemical carbon capture system that removes CO2 from air with 99% efficiency using 35% less energy than current methods.

entries.title: AI model accurately predicts protein-drug interactions
entries.description: DeepMind's latest AlphaFold variant can now predict how proteins interact with potential drug compounds with 94% accuracy, potentially accelerating drug discovery.
